stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist oversees sterile compounding in a pharmacy licensed under M.G.L. c. 112, § 39G and also administers vaccines. Which continuing education overlays apply to her? Select all that apply.

choices.text: At least five contact hours per calendar year in sterile compounding.
At least one contact hour on immunizations during the two-year renewal cycle.
At least two contact hours per calendar year in pharmacy law.
At least three contact hours per calendar year in complex non-sterile compounding.
At least ten contact hours per calendar year in sterile compounding because she both oversees and practises in a licensed setting.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 4.03(4)(c) requires five contact hours per calendar year in sterile compounding for a registrant who oversees or is directly engaged in it or practises in a § 39G or § 39I pharmacy. 247 CMR 4.03(4)(e) requires one immunization contact hour per two-year cycle. 247 CMR 4.03(4)(a) requires two pharmacy law contact hours per calendar year of every registrant. The complex non-sterile overlay attaches to § 39H practice, which is not present, and the overlays are not doubled for satisfying more than one trigger.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: five contact hours per calendar year for sterile compounding.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: one immunization contact hour across the two-year cycle.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: the pharmacy law overlay applies to every registrant each calendar year.
choice_analysis.D: The complex non-sterile overlay attaches to § 39H practice, which these facts do not include.
choice_analysis.E: Meeting more than one trigger for the same overlay does not multiply the requirement.

related_facts: The compounding overlays are measured per calendar year while the immunization overlay is measured per renewal cycle.
explanation.mpje_trap: Overlaps in triggers do not add up; the sterile compounding overlay is five hours however many triggers apply.

reasoning_steps: Identify each practice trigger the pharmacist actually meets
Match each trigger to its overlay and to whether it is annual or per cycle
Refuse to double an overlay that has more than one qualifying trigger
